faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What does an interior architect for showroom design do in Karnal?

We plan the façade, display layout, lighting, customer route and storage, so your showroom stands out on busy roads and makes products easy to browse.

Do you design automobile and furniture showrooms?

Yes. Automobile, furniture, jewellery and apparel showrooms each need different display heights, lighting and space, and we plan around your product.

Can a showroom follow a national brand's guidelines?

Yes. We adapt brand guidelines to your site, so the showroom meets the brand's standards while fitting the local building.

Why hire an interior architect for showroom design early?

Early planning fixes services, lighting and display positions before work starts, which saves time and keeps the opening date on track.
